title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC Type A - Bilateral Program)
provider: Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China / China Scholarship Council (CSC)
application_deadline: Varies by country; typically January-February for the 2026/2027 cycle (e.g., Feb 14, 2026 for the Bahamas; Feb 8, 2026 for Indonesia; Jan 10, 2026 for Bangladesh)
eligibility_summary: Must be a citizen of a country other than the People's Republic of China, in good health both mentally and physically. Applied through the Chinese Embassy/Consulate or bilateral government agency in the applicant's home country (Agency Number varies by country).
funding_details: Full tuition waiver, free on-campus accommodation or accommodation subsidy, monthly living allowance (CNY 2,500 for undergraduate, CNY 3,000 for master's, CNY 3,500 for doctoral, CNY 2,500 for senior scholars), comprehensive medical insurance, and international round-trip airfare (bilateral program only). CSCA Score Report required for bachelor's degree applicants intending to enroll in September 2026 (exam dates: Dec 21, 2025 or Jan 25, 2026).
duration: Bachelor's: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-3 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years; Senior Scholar: 1-2 years (no extension)

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC Type B - Chinese University Program)
application_deadline: Varies by university; typically January-February for the 2026/2027 cycle. Each university sets its own internal deadline for CSC nomination (e.g., February 27, 2026 at Tsinghua; January 31, 2026 at UCAS; March 9-17, 2026 at Peking University)
eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizenship, good health. Applicants apply directly to a participating Chinese university and must be nominated by that university to CSC. Each applicant may submit no more than 3 CSC applications total (max 2 Type A, 1 Type B) in an enrollment year. Cannot accept other government/university scholarships simultaneously (excluding one-time awards).
funding_details: Full tuition waiver, free on-campus accommodation or accommodation subsidy, monthly living allowance (CNY 2,500 for undergraduate, CNY 3,000 for master's, CNY 3,500 for doctoral), comprehensive medical insurance. Does NOT include international travel expenses (unlike Type A).
duration: Bachelor's: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-3 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years

title: Chinese Government Scholarship for International Students to Study at UCAS (CSC Type B at UCAS)
provider: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS) / China Scholarship Council (CSC)
eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport, friendly to China, abiding by Chinese laws and UCAS regulations. Proficient in English or Mandarin. Master's applicants must have a bachelor's degree or equivalent and be no more than 35 years old. PhD applicants must have a master's degree or equivalent and be no more than 40 years old. Must not currently be pursuing a degree at any university/institution in China. Must not accept other sponsorship during the scholarship period.
funding_details: Tuition waiver (PhD: RMB 40,000/year; Master: RMB 30,000/year). Application fee waiver (RMB 600). Monthly stipend of RMB 5,000 for PhD (RMB 1,500 from supervisor/CAS institute) and RMB 3,500 for Master (RMB 500 from supervisor/CAS institute). Free on-campus accommodation in Beijing or accommodation subsidy (up to RMB 700/month for Master, RMB 1,000/month for PhD). Medical insurance (RMB 800/year).
duration: Master: 36 months (no extension); PhD: 36 months (with permitted extension of no more than 12 months)

title: UCAS Scholarship for International Students 2026
provider: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)
application_deadline: January 31, 2026 (Beijing Time) for PhD/Master; no deadline for visiting student programs
eligibility_summary: Not hold Chinese citizenship, valid foreign passport, friendly to China, abiding by Chinese laws and UCAS rules. Proficient in English or Chinese. PhD applicants born after Jan 1, 1991; Master's applicants born after Jan 1, 1996; Senior visiting born after Jan 1, 1981; Regular visiting born after Jan 1, 1986; Joint program applicants no age limit. Must meet UCAS international student admission criteria. Must not take up other assignments during scholarship period. Currently enrolled students in China are ineligible for degree programs at the same level.
funding_details: Full Scholarship: Tuition waiver (PhD: RMB 40,000/year; Master: RMB 30,000/year). Monthly stipend of RMB 2,500 for PhD and RMB 2,000 for Master, PLUS research assistantship from host supervisor/CAS institute bringing total to no less than RMB 3,500 for PhD and RMB 3,000 for Master. Free basic accommodation in Beijing (or accommodation support at CAS institutes outside Beijing). Medical insurance (RMB 800/year). Application fee waiver (RMB 600). Partial Scholarship covers tuition, medical insurance, and application fee.
duration: Master/Doctoral: up to 36 months; Visiting students: 6-24 months

title: CAS-ANSO Scholarship (Degree Program) 2026
provider: Alliance of National and International Science Organizations for the Belt and Road Regions (ANSO) / Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS)
application_opening_date: October 15, 2025 (through UCAS or USTC admission systems)
eligibility_summary: Not hold Chinese citizenship, valid foreign passport, friendly to China, abiding by Chinese laws and UCAS rules. Proficient in English or Chinese. Master's applicants born after Jan 1, 1996; PhD applicants born after Jan 1, 1991. Must meet UCAS/USTC admission criteria. Must not take up other assignments during scholarship period. Must not currently be pursuing a degree at any university/institution in China. NOT allowed to apply to both USTC and UCAS simultaneously.
funding_details: Tuition fees (waived). Monthly stipend. Free on-campus accommodation or accommodation subsidy. Comprehensive medical insurance. Application fee waiver. Travel allowances (sub-country level; no travel subsidy for awardees already on site in China). Sub-category: ANSO-CAS-TWAS/UNESCO PhD Scholarship (up to 40 PhD students from developing countries annually, prioritizing climate-related research, Least Developed Countries, and women researchers).
duration: Master: up to 36 months; PhD: up to 36 months (with possible extension)
annual_number_of_awards: 100-200 Master's students and 300 PhD students annually across USTC and UCAS

title: Chinese Government Scholarship for Advanced Graduate Program at Peking University (CSC Type B)
application_deadline: March 9, 2026 (Peking University International Student Service System) / March 17, 2026 (China Scholarship Council system)
eligibility_summary: Must meet Peking University admission requirements for international students. Must have successfully submitted application for 2026 full-time self-funded graduate programs. Must not have received other Chinese government or PKU scholarships (except one-time non-renewable merit awards). Must not be a joint training program candidate. Single CSC application allowed (one major only).
funding_details: Full or partial tuition waiver, living stipend, housing (for-free accommodation), and medical insurance. CSC Application Portal: https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn. PKU Agency/University Code: 10001. Type: B (Chinese University Program).

title: Peking University Scholarship (PKUS) 2026
eligibility_summary: Must meet Peking University admission requirements for international students. Must have successfully submitted application for 2026 full-time self-funded graduate programs. Must not have received any other forms of scholarship funding. Must not be a joint training program candidate. One-time application considered for multiple scholarships (CGS, PKUS, BGS) based on merit.
funding_details: Full or partial tuition waiver, living stipend, and medical insurance. No separate application required beyond the unified PKU scholarship application.

title: Beijing Government Scholarship (BGS) at Peking University 2026
eligibility_summary: Must meet Peking University admission requirements for international students. Must have successfully submitted application for 2026 full-time self-funded graduate programs. Must not have received any other scholarship from Chinese government, social organizations, or Peking University (except one-time non-renewable merit awards).
funding_details: Full or partial tuition waiver. Three types: Type A (tuition + free accommodation + medical insurance + monthly living expenses), Type B (tuition + free accommodation + medical insurance), Type C (tuition + medical insurance).

title: Chinese Government Scholarship at Tsinghua University (CGS Type B)
application_opening_date: December 2025 (Tsinghua graduate application portal opens September 30, 2025; pre-admission highly recommended before December 15, 2025)
eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree holder under age 35 for master's programs; Master's degree holder under age 40 for doctoral programs. Must acquire HSK Level 4 for Chinese-taught master's or doctoral programs. Must be pre-admitted by Tsinghua University and recommended by the pre-admitted schools/departments. Must not have been offered other scholarships from Chinese government or Tsinghua University (except one-time awards). Must meet applicable program/major/nationality requirements of CGS Type B.
funding_details: Full CGS: tuition fees, free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy, monthly stipend, comprehensive medical insurance. Partial CGS includes one or some items from the Full CGS coverage. Annual review required each year.
duration: Master's degree: 1-3 years; Doctoral degree: 4-5 years
cycle: 2025/2026 and 2026/2027 (application opens Sep 30, 2025, deadline Feb 28, 2026; intake September 2026)

title: Tsinghua University Institutional Scholarship (Tsinghua University Scholarship)
application_deadline: February 28, 2026 (Second Round / English Taught Programs deadline)
eligibility_summary: International undergraduate applicants to Tsinghua University. No separate scholarship application required; selection based on admission materials (GPA, language scores, recommendations, study plan). Must also meet general Tsinghua admission requirements.
funding_details: Full or partial tuition waiver. Coverage varies based on applicant merit. Typically covers all or part of tuition fees.
duration: Up to 4 years (duration of undergraduate program)
cycle: 2025/2026 and 2026/2027 (application opens Sep 30, 2025; two rounds with deadlines Nov 28, 2025 and Feb 28, 2026)

title: Asian Future Leaders Scholarship Program (AFLSP) 2026
provider: Bai Xian Asia Institute (BXAI) / Tsinghua University
application_deadline: March 1, 2026 (Beijing Time) for scholarship application materials
eligibility_summary: Must be non-Chinese citizens from Asia (citizens of Asian countries). Must meet Tsinghua University admission requirements for international master's students. Must demonstrate academic excellence, leadership potential, integrity, good English proficiency and presentation skills. Must not be offered other scholarships for study at Tsinghua. Must be able to attend mandatory enrichment programs at Beijing campus (not open to Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School applicants).
funding_details: Tuition fees; Living allowance (including accommodation, books, or other materials).
additional_requirements: Recipients must participate in BXAI Summer Program (up to 3 weeks in August 2027), all mandatory enrichment programs, sign a commitment letter and hold themselves as 'Bai Xian Scholars' for the scholarship period. For two-year scholarship students, must meet satisfactory academic requirements in the first year for second-year disbursement. Must disclose any other scholarships/funding. Must notify BXAI of any exchange or overseas study plans.

title: Atomic Energy Scholarship Program of China 2026
provider: China Atomic Energy Authority (CAEA) / Ministry of Education (MOE) / China Scholarship Council (CSC)
application_deadline: January 31, 2026 (CSC system submission) / February 28, 2026 (Tsinghua grad application)
eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries other than PRC committed to the nuclear industry for societal benefit, in good health. Holders of Bachelor's or Master's degree in relevant majors (nuclear engineering, nuclear technology, mechanics, energy, chemical engineering, physics) with strong scientific research capability. Proficiency in English. Master's applicants under 35 years old; PhD applicants under 40 years old. Preference given to those with work experience in nuclear or related fields.
funding_details: Tuition fees; Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy; Monthly stipend; Comprehensive medical insurance.
eligible_departments: Department of Engineering Physics and Institute of Nuclear and New Energy Technology at Tsinghua University

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Chinese University Program) at Fudan University 2026
application_deadline: January 31, 2026 (typically, aligned with other Fudan CSC scholarships and UCAS pattern)
eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens in good health, meeting Fudan University admission requirements. Must apply through Fudan University's international admissions system and indicate intention for CSC scholarship consideration. Must secure pre-admission from Fudan.
funding_details: Standard CSC coverage: Full tuition waiver, free on-campus accommodation or accommodation subsidy, monthly living allowance (CNY 2,500 for undergraduate, CNY 3,000 for master's, CNY 3,500 for doctoral), comprehensive medical insurance. Does not include international travel (Type B - Chinese University Program).
duration: Bachelor's: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-2 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Youth of Excellence Scheme) at Fudan University 2026
application_deadline: January 31, 2026 (typically, aligned with other Fudan CSC scholarships)
eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens in good health, meeting Fudan University admission requirements. Open to youth of excellence applicants. Must apply through Fudan University's international admissions system. Must secure pre-admission from Fudan.
funding_details: Standard CSC coverage: Full tuition waiver, free on-campus accommodation or accommodation subsidy, monthly living allowance (CNY 2,500 for undergraduate, CNY 3,000 for master's, CNY 3,500 for doctoral), comprehensive medical insurance. This is a CSC sub-program with a specific focus on youth of excellence applicants.
duration: Bachelor's: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-2 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years

title: Shanghai Government Scholarship at Fudan University 2026
application_deadline: January 31, 2026 (typically, aligned with other Fudan scholarships)
eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens in good health, meeting Fudan University admission requirements. Must apply through Fudan University's international admissions system and indicate intention for Shanghai Government Scholarship consideration.
funding_details: Full tuition waiver, free on-campus accommodation or accommodation subsidy, monthly living allowance, comprehensive medical insurance. Funding level follows Shanghai Government Scholarship standards (typically comparable to CSC standards).
duration: Bachelor's: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-2 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS - China Embassy, Dhaka) 2025/2026
provider: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in Bangladesh / China Scholarship Council (CSC)
eligibility_summary: Bangladeshi students who are outstanding and wish to pursue degree programs or Chinese language program in Chinese universities. Must be in good health and meet university admission requirements.
funding_details: Full tuition fees, on-campus accommodation, comprehensive medical insurance, monthly living allowance (approximately CNY 2,500-3,500 depending on program level), international round-trip airfare.
duration: Duration of the degree program or one year for language program
contact: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in Bangladesh

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS - China Embassy, Jakarta) 2026/2027
provider: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in Indonesia / China Scholarship Council (CSC)
eligibility_summary: Indonesian citizens (non-PRC), in good mental and physical health, not Chinese citizens. China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program. Must meet admission requirements of target universities. Applicants for English-taught programs must provide IELTS/TOEFL scores.
funding_details: Full scholarship coverage: tuition fees, on-campus accommodation, comprehensive medical insurance, monthly living allowance, international round-trip airfare (for bilateral program). CSCA exam required for bachelor's applicants intending September 2026 enrollment (exam dates: Dec 21, 2025 or Jan 25, 2026).
duration: Undergraduate: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-3 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years
annual_number_of_awards: 20 places for undergraduate/master's/doctoral programs (China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program)
contact: Email: eduindonesia@163.com, Tel: 021-5761263, Indonesian Agency Number: 3602

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS - China Embassy, Nassau) 2026/2027
provider: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in the Bahamas / China Scholarship Council (CSC)
eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens, in good health both mentally and physically. Applied through Chinese Embassy in Bahamas (Bahamas Program Category A, Agency Number 0441). Must submit CSCA Score Report for bachelor's degree applicants intending September 2026 enrollment. Pre-admission documents required from target universities.
funding_details: Full scholarship: tuition fees, accommodation (free on-campus or subsidy), monthly living allowance, comprehensive medical insurance. Two tracks: (1) Bilateral Scholarship - 1 place, includes international travel expenses; (2) Unilateral Scholarship - 3 places, does not include international travel expenses.
duration: Bachelor's: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-3 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years
